name: perform_screen_action
description: Perform a specific, non-destructive action in the visible user interface.

name: perform_file_operation
description: Perform a specific non-destructive file creation, copy, move, or organization task.

name: ask_clarification
description: Ask the user for a missing required detail or to resolve an ambiguous reference before any action is taken.

name: confirm_destructive_action
description: Request explicit confirmation before deleting, erasing, overwriting, uninstalling, force-quitting, or discarding user data.
